DRI / Project owner

 

Team

 

Research and Context

  • Goal: reduce subscription churn and increase upsell conversions by clarifying whether users intend to cancel only Pro or all subscriptions
  • Foundation:
    • — the study highlighted the problem that users do not understand that the songbook+course bundle purchased during the upsell is a separate subscription
    • user reviews left via support also mention this
    • due to this misunderstanding, they do not cancel the trial for the purchased bundle and then process a refund through refand. the idea behind the project is to make it clear when canceling what exactly the user is canceling and whether they want to cancel the purchased upsell bundle along with the subscription

Research results

Refunds & Disputes research shows that most refunds in upsells come from users who canceled their Pro subscription trial period. From this, we can conclude that a large number of refunds come from users who canceled their subscription, even though they had already paid for the bundle, and were dissatisfied with it 

Usability research

Usability research revealed that users did not understand that they were taking out several different subscriptions, which also had to be canceled separately.

ScreenConclusionExample reviews

 When users want to cancel, they don't understand that they have to cancel 2 subscriptions and cancel only oneI now have two subscriptions, and I thought I just had one. But now do I have to cancel my other subscription? Um, it'd be my understanding that I have totally canceled all my subscriptions, so, oh, okay. [She didn't cancel the second]

Refund Cases Analysis

ScreenExample reviews

Customers believed they were signing up for one service, but unknowingly committed to two separate subscriptions

Users thought courses/songbooks were included in the main subscription (as a bonus/bundle).

Users attempted to cancel but didn't realize they needed to cancel multiple services.

Users describe being overwhelmed by pop-ups and an unclear signup flow, which led to mistakes and accidental activations. 

I only wanted to try out the UG Pro to see if it would help my project, and it didn't have the song I needed.

I was using Ultimate Guitar to find sheet music for my guitarist that was not on praise charts.

I wanted only access to song words and chords and the ability to change the keys of the songs.

I only signed up for a trial of UG Pro+ to be able to download a tab to print off a hard copy.

The reason for my trial period was that I wanted to print 2-3 songs on August 15th, nothing more.

I just wanted to buy chords for my singing lessons.

I am a worship team leader at my church, and I was using Ultimate Guitar to find sheet music.

So I was preparing for our church's musical event. I had 30 songs to prepare and practice.

I only wanted to order the basic Ultimate Guitar subscription because I only need to access the lyrics and chords.

I subscribed to see what was new since the last time I used the product.

I'm a guitar beginner. A few days ago, I found this website on the internet, and I tried to find out whether this guitar resource fits me.
